key_difference: (D) uses the signal's class as the completeness-check discriminator, which is shared across translation units, so the cross-TU folding of different completeness results that the reviewer flagged can still happen; (B) avoids this with an anonymous-namespace UniqueType (unique per TU) threaded through is_complete, without changing the ConnectionTypes call sites in qobject.h and qobject_p.h.
